prompt:
Create ONE standalone TAKY exploration badge master candidate per request. High-density pastel hand-drawn illustration, circular badge composition, cute but not childish, collectible/premium, transparent outside the circular composition. BADGE 001 current display item: 이불 왕국 탈출기

Authority motif: 이불에서 삐져나온 작은 태양
Exact production scene: Do not draw a literal castle, architecture, horizon, sunrise, ladder, flag, or any character. Show a clearly recognizable SOFT QUILTED BLANKET with subtle stitched seams and plush folds filling most of the circular badge. Its folds make one small gate-like opening. A NON-ANTHROPOMORPHIC FULL round SUN with NO face has already squeezed through the opening and is clearly in front/outside the blanket gap, moving diagonally toward the lower-right foreground. Give the sun 4 short simple soft rays around its upper half so it unmistakably reads as a sun at 64px, while still avoiding any sunrise/horizon composition. Add a short trailing warm glow from the blanket gap and a slightly pushed-aside blanket fold to show escape motion. The visual joke: the blanket itself is the kingdom, and the sun has escaped from it. 64px must read: quilted blanket gate behind + full sun with rays escaping in front.
Generate only ONE standalone badge artwork, centered. No contact sheet, no multiple options.
Do not render the Korean display item or any text.
